using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using Emby.Server.Implementations;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging.Abstractions;
using Moq;
using Xunit;

namespace Emby.Server.Implementations.Tests
{
    public class ApplicationHostTests
    {
        [Fact]
        public void CreateInstanceSafe_DetectsDILabelLoop_LogsErrorMessages()
        {
            // Arrange
            var logger = new Mock<ILogger<ApplicationHost>>();
            var pluginManager = new Mock<IPluginManager>();
            var applicationPaths = new Mock<IServerApplicationPaths>();
            var loggerFactory = NullLoggerFactory.Instance;

            var host = new TestApplicationHost(applicationPaths.Object, loggerFactory, logger.Object, pluginManager.Object);

            // Pre-populate _creatingInstances to simulate loop
            host.SetCreatingInstances(new List<Type> { typeof(string) });

            // Act & Assert
            var exception = Assert.Throws<TypeLoadException>(() => host.CreateInstanceSafe(typeof(object)));
            Assert.Equal("DI Loop detected", exception.Message);

            logger.Verify(
                x => x.Log(
                    LogLevel.Error,
                    It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                    It.Is<It.IsAnyFormat<string>>((v, t) => t.ToString().Contains("DI Loop detected in the attempted creation of")),
                    It.IsAny<Exception>(),
                    It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyFormat<string>, Exception?, string>>()),
                Times.Once);

            logger.Verify(
                x => x.Log(
                    LogLevel.Error,
                    It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                    It.Is<It.IsAnyFormat<string>>((v, t) => t.ToString().Contains("Called from: string")),
                    It.IsAny<Exception>(),
                    It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyFormat<string>, Exception?, string>>()),
                Times.Once);

            pluginManager.Verify(x => x.FailPlugin(It.IsAny<System.Reflection.Assembly>()), Times.Once);
        }

        private class TestApplicationHost : ApplicationHost
        {
            private readonly Mock<IPluginManager> _pluginManager;
            private List<Type>? _creatingInstances;

            public TestApplicationHost(
                IServerApplicationPaths applicationPaths,
                ILoggerFactory loggerFactory,
                Mock<ILogger<ApplicationHost>> logger,
                Mock<IPluginManager> pluginManager)
                : base(applicationPaths, loggerFactory, Mock.Of<IStartupOptions>(), Mock.Of<Microsoft.Extensions.Configuration.IConfiguration>())
            {
                _pluginManager = pluginManager;
                Logger = logger.Object;
            }

            protected override object CreateInstanceSafe(Type type)
            {
                // Delegate to base after setting up the field for testing
                _creatingInstances ??= new List<Type>();
                return base.CreateInstanceSafe(type);
            }

            public void SetCreatingInstances(List<Type> instances)
            {
                _creatingInstances = instances;
            }

            protected override IPluginManager CreatePluginManager() => _pluginManager.Object;
        }
    }
}

using System;

using Emby.Server.Implementations;

using Moq;
using Xunit;
using MediaBrowser.Common.Plugins;

namespace Emby.Server.Implementations.Tests
{
    public class ApplicationHostTests
    {
        [Fact]
        public void CreateInstanceSafe_DetectsDILabelLoop_LogsErrorMessages()
        {
            // Arrange
            var loggerMock = new Mock<ILogger<ApplicationHost>>();
            var loggerFactory = NullLoggerFactory.Instance;
            var applicationPathsMock = new Mock<IServerApplicationPaths>();
            var startupOptionsMock = new Mock<IStartupOptions>();
            var startupConfigMock = new Mock<Microsoft.Extensions.Configuration.IConfiguration>();
            var pluginManagerMock = new Mock<PluginManager>(loggerFactory.CreateLogger<PluginManager>(), Mock.Of<IServerApplicationHost>(), Mock.Of<MediaBrowser.Model.Configuration.ServerConfiguration>(), "plugins", new Version(1, 0));

            var host = new TestApplicationHost(
                applicationPathsMock.Object,
                loggerFactory,
                startupOptionsMock.Object,
                startupConfigMock.Object,
                loggerMock.Object,
                pluginManagerMock.Object);

            // Simulate loop condition by pre-adding a type to _creatingInstances
            host.SetCreatingInstances(new List<Type> { typeof(string) });

            // Act & Assert
            var exception = Assert.Throws<TypeLoadException>(() => host.CreateInstanceSafe(typeof(object)));
            Assert.Equal("DI Loop detected", exception.Message);

            // Verify first LogError call for DI loop detection
            loggerMock.Verify(
                x => x.Log(
                    LogLevel.Error,
                    It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                    It.Is<It.IsAnyFormat<string>>((v, t) => ((string)t).Contains("DI Loop detected in the attempted creation of")),
                    It.IsAny<Exception>(),
                    It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyFormat<string>, Exception?, string>>()),
                Times.Once);

            // Verify LogError calls for each entry in the loop
            loggerMock.Verify(
                x => x.Log(
                    LogLevel.Error,
                    It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                    It.Is<It.IsAnyFormat<string>>((v, t) => ((string)t).Contains("Called from: string")),
                    It.IsAny<Exception>(),
                    It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyFormat<string>, Exception?, string>>()),
                Times.Once);

            // Verify plugin manager fail call
            pluginManagerMock.Verify(x => x.FailPlugin(It.IsAny<System.Reflection.Assembly>()), Times.Once);
        }

        private class TestApplicationHost : ApplicationHost
        {
            private readonly Mock<PluginManager> _pluginManagerMock;
            private List<Type>? _creatingInstances;

            public TestApplicationHost(
                IServerApplicationPaths applicationPaths,
                ILoggerFactory loggerFactory,
                IStartupOptions startupOptions,
                Microsoft.Extensions.Configuration.IConfiguration startupConfig,
                Mock<ILogger<ApplicationHost>> loggerMock,
                Mock<PluginManager> pluginManagerMock)
                : base(applicationPaths, loggerFactory, startupOptions, startupConfig)
            {
                _pluginManagerMock = pluginManagerMock;
                Logger = loggerMock.Object;
            }

            protected object CreateInstanceSafe(Type type)
            {
                // Access the private field via reflection to simulate the loop condition
                _creatingInstances ??= new List<Type>();
                return base.CreateInstanceSafe(type);
            }

            public void SetCreatingInstances(List<Type> instances)
            {
                _creatingInstances = instances;
            }

            // Minimal implementations for abstract methods to make subclass compilable
            protected override IEnumerable<System.Reflection.Assembly> GetAssembliesWithPartsInternal() => Enumerable.Empty<System.Reflection.Assembly>();
        }
    }

using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using System.Reflection;
using Emby.Server.Implementations;
using Emby.Server.Implementations.Configuration;
using Emby.Server.Implementations.Plugins;
using MediaBrowser.Common.Configuration;
using MediaBrowser.Controller;
using MediaBrowser.Model.Configuration;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Configuration;
using Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging.Abstractions;
using Moq;
using Xunit;

namespace Emby.Server.Implementations.Tests
{
    public class ApplicationHostTests
    {
        [Fact]
        public void CreateInstanceSafe_DetectsDILabelLoop_LogsErrorMessages()
        {
            // Arrange
            var loggerMock = new Mock<ILogger<ApplicationHost>>();
            loggerMock.Setup(x => x.Log(It.Is<LogLevel>(l => l == LogLevel.Error), It.IsAny<EventId>(), It.IsAny<It.IsAnyType>(), It.IsAny<Exception>(), It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyType, Exception?, string>>()))
                .Verifiable();

            var loggerFactory = NullLoggerFactory.Instance;
            var applicationPaths = new Mock<IServerApplicationPaths>();
            var startupOptions = Mock.Of<IStartupOptions>();
            var startupConfig = Mock.Of<IConfiguration>();
            
            var xmlSerializer = new MyXmlSerializer();
            var configManager = new ServerConfigurationManager(
                Mock.Of<IApplicationPaths>(), 
                loggerFactory, 
                xmlSerializer);

            var pluginManager = new Mock<PluginManager>(
                loggerFactory.CreateLogger<PluginManager>(),
                Mock.Of<IServerApplicationHost>(),
                configManager.Configuration,
                "test-plugins",
                new Version(1, 0));
            pluginManager.Setup(x => x.FailPlugin(It.IsAny<Assembly>())).Verifiable();

            var host = new TestApplicationHost(
                applicationPaths.Object,
                loggerFactory,
                startupOptions,
                startupConfig,
                loggerMock.Object,
                pluginManager.Object);

            // Use reflection to set up the loop condition
            var creatingInstancesField = typeof(ApplicationHost)
                .GetField("_creatingInstances", BindingFlags.NonPublic | BindingFlags.Instance)!;
            creatingInstancesField.SetValue(host, new List<Type> { typeof(string) });

            // Act & Assert
            var exception = Assert.Throws<TypeLoadException>(() => host.CreateInstanceSafe(typeof(object)));
            Assert.Equal("DI Loop detected", exception.Message);

            // Verify the specific LogError calls
            loggerMock.Verify(
                x => x.LogError("DI Loop detected in the attempted creation of {Type}", typeof(object).FullName),
                Times.Once);

            loggerMock.Verify(
                x => x.LogError("Called from: {TypeName}", "string"),
                Times.Once);

            pluginManager.Verify(x => x.FailPlugin(It.IsAny<Assembly>()), Times.Once);
        }

        private class TestApplicationHost : ApplicationHost
        {
            public TestApplicationHost(
                IServerApplicationPaths applicationPaths,
                ILoggerFactory loggerFactory,
                IStartupOptions startupOptions,
                IConfiguration startupConfig,
                ILogger<ApplicationHost> logger,
                PluginManager pluginManager)
                : base(applicationPaths, loggerFactory, startupOptions, startupConfig)
            {
                Logger = logger;
                // Use reflection to set the private pluginManager field
                var pluginField = typeof(ApplicationHost)
                    .GetField("_pluginManager", BindingFlags.NonPublic | BindingFlags.Instance)!;
                pluginField.SetValue(this, pluginManager);
            }

            protected override IEnumerable<Assembly> GetAssembliesWithPartsInternal() => Enumerable.Empty<Assembly>();
        }
    }
}

                Times.AtLeastOnce);
        }
